inline_text:
Starts D2 in GitHub, as discussed with Jordan on Discord, so the outline can be reviewed line by line. It follows the same shape as D1 (#8).

## What's here
- `D2-gap-analysis-benchmark-survey/README.md`: charter purpose, narrative, and an index of sections and cards.
- `01`–`10`: the D2 outline from the running notes ("High level narrative" section), lightly edited for Markdown. The consumer/producer trust discussion in §4 is slightly condensed; please check it against the notes.
- `cards/TEMPLATE.md`: question-card format from the 10 Nov slides.
- `cards/Q-PRD-02-side-effect-safety.md`: a first card, "How do I make sure an agent's side effects happen exactly once when tools fail or time out?" It pairs with Q-PRD-01 (durable execution), listed as a placeholder for Jordan.

## Proposals to discuss (not decided)
- Answer §6–8 as question cards grouped by lifecycle stage (noted in §6).
- Merge the two gap vocabularies (§8 categories vs the slides' missing/partial/fragmented/unmeasurable/unadopted), ideally via D1.

Draft so the D2 participants can shape it before anything is merged. cc @jordanauge @Sanjeev-S, and Brian Malone (I couldn't find Brian's GitHub handle).
